nodes.description: Public uint256 upper limit of NFT supply set to 8888; bounds minting in claim().
Private mapping(uint256=>uint256) storing the block.timestamp recorded per tokenId; read by pluck() and getBackGround(), written by claim().
Private string array of five-element glyphs used as metadata source in getFiveElements().
Private string array of gossip glyphs used as metadata source in getGossip().
Private string array of ten heavenly stems used as metadata source in getTenDry().
Private string array of earthly branch glyphs used as metadata source in geTearthlyBranch().
Private address in Ownable holding the contract owner; mutated by _setOwner().
Private uint256 reentrancy status in ReentrancyGuard toggled between _NOT_ENTERED and _ENTERED.
Public nonReentrant mint function: derives tokenId from totalSupply()+1, checks maxLimit, writes block.timestamp into numbers and safe-mints to msg.sender.
Public view override assembling the on-chain SVG/JSON metadata, calling getBackGround, pluck-based getters and Base64 encoding.
Internal view helper reading numbers[tokenId] and pseudo-randomly selecting an element from a source array.
Public view returning a Color struct pseudo-randomly derived from keccak of tokenId plus stored number.
Public view returning a five-elements glyph via pluck with key prefix FIVEELEMENTS.
Public view returning a gossip glyph via pluck with key prefix GOSSIP.
Public view returning a heavenly-stem glyph via pluck with key prefix TENDRY.
Public view returning an earthly-branch glyph via pluck with key prefix EARTHLYBRANCH.
Internal pure pseudo-random helper returning uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(input))).
Internal pure uint256 to decimal string converter used for metadata rendering.
KuKai constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and Ownable, invoking _setOwner(_msgSender()).
Private Ownable helper writing the new owner address into _owner and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Public onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner after a zero-address check.
Public onlyOwner function setting the owner to address(0).
Internal ERC721 function minting then invoking _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient contract.
Internal ERC721 function updating balances, owners and invoking the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
Private ERC721 function performing an external try-call to onERC721Received on the recipient contract, enabling callback execution.
Internal virtual hook invoked before any token transfer/mint/burn; overridden by ERC721Enumerable.
msg.sender supplied by the caller via _msgSender(); used for mint recipient and owner authorization.
block.timestamp used as the stored random seed for each minted tokenId in claim().
Unsafe use of block.timestamp as the on-chain randomness seed written into numbers[tokenId]; miner-manipulable and predictable.
External call chain triggered by _safeMint to a recipient contract's onERC721Received, a reentrancy vector.
Low-level external callback invocation of IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on an untrusted recipient contract.
Local variable tokenId = totalSupply()+1 declared inside claim().
Parameter input of the random() pseudo-random helper.
Local variable number = numbers[tokenId] inside pluck().
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership().
Local variable rand = random(...) inside getBackGround().

edges.reason: claim() reads maxLimit to enforce the 8888 supply cap.
claim() writes the timestamp seed into the numbers mapping.
claim() invokes _safeMint, which can trigger recipient callbacks before the guard releases.
block.timestamp flows directly into the random seed write, creating timestamp dependency.
The timestamp-derived seed is persisted into numbers[tokenId].
msg.sender is passed as the mint recipient address to _safeMint.
_safeMint calls _mint to create the token before the receiver check.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received, entering untrusted recipient code.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an external callback into onERC721Received of an untrusted contract.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
pluck() reads numbers[tokenId] as its randomness input.
pluck() calls random() to derive the array index.
getFiveElements() delegates to pluck().
getGossip() delegates to pluck().
getTenDry() delegates to pluck().
geTearthlyBranch() delegates to pluck().
getBackGround() calls random() to compute the greatness value.
getBackGround() reads numbers[tokenId] for its randomness seed.
tokenURI() calls getBackGround() to build the color palette.
tokenURI() calls getFiveElements() to render metadata text.
tokenURI() calls getGossip() to render metadata text.
tokenURI() calls getTenDry() to render metadata text.
tokenURI() calls geTearthlyBranch() to render metadata text.
tokenURI() calls toString() to embed the token id.
getFiveElements() reads the fiveElements array.
getGossip() reads the gossip array.
getTenDry() reads the tenDry array.
geTearthlyBranch() reads the earthlyBranch array.
transferOwnership() calls _setOwner() after the onlyOwner check.
renounceOwnership() calls _setOwner(address(0)) under onlyOwner.
_setOwner() writes the _owner state variable.
The constructor initializes ownership via _setOwner(_msgSender()).
msg.sender must equal owner() for the onlyOwner restriction on transferOwnership().
Local tokenId is computed and used inside claim().
Parameter input is hashed inside random().
Local number is loaded from numbers mapping inside pluck().
Parameter newOwner is forwarded to _setOwner() inside transferOwnership().
Local rand drives the color branch selection inside getBackGround().

normalization_plan.reason: Local tokenId is scoped to claim() and should be absorbed into the claim function node.
Parameter input is only meaningful within random() and merges into that function node.
Local number is only meaningful within pluck() and merges into that function node.
Parameter newOwner is only meaningful within transferOwnership() and merges into that function node.
Local rand is only meaningful within getBackGround() and merges into that function node.
